name: Gakkou no Nanafushigi
source:
Nanami, the protagonist, has just transferred schools and is feeling down because she hasn’t made any friends.  
Then, one day, she meets Hanako  in the bathroom and they become friends—but?..

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5229]freem[/url]]
translation:
主角七海刚刚转学，因为没有交到朋友而心情低落。
然后，有一天，她在浴室遇到了花子，他们成为了朋友——但是？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5229]freem[/url]]
